about: Every NBA player with a completed game this season, scored with this league's settings. Ranked by fantasy points per game; players with fewer than 7 games (40% of a typical team's games) have rank null and come last. change = places moved since 2026-11-21 (positive = up). lockValue = the score you'd expect to keep in a 3-4 game Lock-In week: fpPerGame x spikeFactor, where spikeFactor comes from the lock math on his games (blended with the league's typical spread, weighted games : 10); lockRank = rank by lockValue. owner = team in this league, or Free agent.
